hubLoopCapture.description: 4-client piloted hub -> sprint match -> podium -> hub loop on one RAA port, in a 2x2 grid of 960x540 viewports, with PNG captures and flow events

captureAt.description: Strictly ordered subset: hub (120 frames with 3 remotes each), match (600 frames after all enter), podium (60 frames after all enter), back-in-hub (120 frames after done)

hubLoopCapture.output: { captures: [{ name: 'hub-loop-<name>', width: 1920, height: 1080, mime: 'image/png', base64 }], adapter: { vendor, architecture, description, software }, renderer: 'raa', events }

roundCapture.description: 4-client in-page sprint round on one RAA port (2x2 grid of 960x540), PNG captures with the HUD drawn on
roundCapture.output: { captures: [{ name: 'round-<t>s', width, height, mime: 'image/png', base64 }], adapter: { vendor, architecture, description, software }, renderer: 'raa' }

frameTiming.description: 1 client rendering race-bean-dash (40 obstacles, 8 characters) at 1920x1080: port.render frameMs over requestAnimationFrame frames after 60 warm-up frames
frameTiming.output: { p50Ms, p95Ms (nearest rank), frames, adapter: { vendor, architecture, description, software } }
